FederatedPhase.description:
Kind of federated activity a round belongs to.

The three scientific phases are kept separate because they need different
aggregation strategies. ``INFRASTRUCTURE`` is the only phase with tasks
implemented in Stage 1.
FederatedPhase.title: FederatedPhase

HorizonLogisticSpec.description:
Comparator: one logistic regression per horizon.

``ipcw`` weights participants by the inverse probability of remaining
uncensored; ``complete_case`` drops those censored before the horizon
(known to be biased, kept as a reference). Neither ever labels a
participant censored at or before the horizon as a non-converter.
HorizonLogisticSpec.title: HorizonLogisticSpec

SequentialRanking.description: Filters on reliability/agreement, then ranks by relevance only.
SequentialRanking.title: SequentialRanking

SimulationSpec.description:
Single-machine simulation settings.

In a distributed deployment this section does not exist: each institution
keeps its own local data configuration, which the coordinator never sees.
SimulationSpec.title: SimulationSpec

Ranks by a weighted mean of per-dimension percentile ranks.

Provided to *compare* weightings; no weighting is preferred by the code.
